thread:
Olivia (Support): Hey team — NovaHealth just flagged that their onboarding promo (NOVA-ENT-2026) landed in their Hosted dev org instead of the Dedicated prod tenant we promised. Customer is seeing the $12,000 credit on their Hosted invoices and the Dedicated subscription still shows full balance. Can someone take a look? tenant ids below:

- customer_org: novahealth
- hosted_tenant_id: t_host_87ab
- dedicated_tenant_id: t_ded_9f34
- promo_code: NOVA-ENT-2026
- grant_id: g_2026_nova_11

Olivia (Support): Repro steps from onboarding script (what we ran):

```
POST /internal/promos/apply
{ "code": "NOVA-ENT-2026", "org_slug": "novahealth", "env": "auto" }
```

It looks like the service used org_slug and matched the first tenant (hosted dev) due to a slug collision between their sandboxes and their Dedicated tenant. :grimacing:

Leo (Billing): :eyes: I can see grant g_2026_nova_11 attached to t_host_87ab in billing-dashboard. Amount $12000, SKU assigned: hosted_dev_monthly_1. We need to move it to t_ded_9f34 and change SKU to dedicated_monthly_4xA100 (customer signed Dedicated M commitment). Also need to fix any invoice lines that applied the credit already.

Emily (CSM): Customer is getting nervous — they were told Dedicated would be covered for first 3 months. They saw the Hosted credit applied and are worried about double-billing. We should confirm no double-dip and tell them ETA.

Mark (Engineering): I can move the grant but want to be careful: the promo service stores an apply_record with target_tenant and an audit row. Quick check: the grant object currently:

```
{ "id": "g_2026_nova_11", "code": "NOVA-ENT-2026", "amount_cents": 1200000, "applies_to": "hosted", "applied_tenant": "t_host_87ab", "metadata": { "issued_by": "onboard-bot" } }
```

Mark (Engineering): Proposed safe steps:
1) Freeze the grant (set status=held) to prevent further auto-apply.
2) Create a reversing credit to negate the Hosted invoice lines where the promo was consumed (if already used).
3) Reassign grant.applied_tenant -> t_ded_9f34 and applies_to -> "dedicated".
4) Emit audit event and post back to billing so invoices update.

Olivia (Support): Thanks. Customer has only consumed ~$2k so far (according to them). Should we only reverse the consumed portion?

Leo (Billing): Yes, we'll reconcile consumed tokens / invoice lines. If 2000 USD consumed, create reversal of 2000 and then allocate remaining 10000 to Dedicated. I'll need invoice IDs — Olivia can you paste the hosted invoice numbers?

Olivia (Support): Hosted invoice ids: inv-H-77721, inv-H-77722 (both in February). They show promo line: "promo:NOVA-ENT-2026 -1200.00" on each. Total consumed = 2000.

promo-bot: Automated note: promo-service flagged possible org_slug collision for code NOVA-ENT-2026 (match_count=2) at 2026-03-19T15:22:11Z. Recommend manual reassignment.

Mark (Engineering): I'll run the transfer script but need billing sign-off to create the reversal and confirm accounting. Command I will run (dry-run first):
```
./tools/promo-move --grant g_2026_nova_11 --from t_host_87ab --to t_ded_9f34 --new-sku dedicated_monthly_4xA100 --dry-run
```

Mark (Engineering): Sending dry-run output now:

```
DRY RUN: would update grant g_2026_nova_11: applies_to hosted->dedicated, applied_tenant t_host_87ab->t_ded_9f34, create reversal entries for inv-H-77721, inv-H-77722 totaling $2000, allocate remaining $10000 to t_ded_9f34.
```

Leo (Billing): OK to proceed with actual run once I create reversal transactions. I'll create reversal for inv-H-77721/22 for $2000, post them as credit memos, and then sign-off. ETA 2 hours.

Emily (CSM): I'll message NovaHealth and say we're fixing the billing and moving the remainder to their Dedicated tenant; ETA ~2-3 hours. Keep me updated so I can tell them when it's done.

Olivia (Support): Thanks — please confirm in thread when Mark runs the non-dry command so I can close the support ticket.

Mark (Engineering): Copy — I'll wait for Leo. Once Leo posts reversal memos I'll run (non-dry):
```
./tools/promo-move --grant g_2026_nova_11 --from t_host_87ab --to t_ded_9f34 --new-sku dedicated_monthly_4xA100
```

Mark (Engineering): After move I'll also add a guard to the onboarding script: prefer explicit tenant_id vs org_slug, and add a warning when match_count > 1. Filing a small infra PR after this.

Leo (Billing): Reversals posted: cm-9901 and cm-9902. Total $2000. Proceed, Mark.

Mark (Engineering): Running promo-move now...

Mark (Engineering): Done. Grant updated and audit event emitted: audit-a_44521. New grant state:

```
{ "id": "g_2026_nova_11", "code": "NOVA-ENT-2026", "amount_cents": 1200000, "applies_to": "dedicated", "applied_tenant": "t_ded_9f34", "status": "active", "metadata": { "migrated_by": "mark", "note": "manual reassign after org_slug collision" } }
```

Mark (Engineering): Billing backend received allocation update and applied credit memo offsets to Hosted invoices. Please verify customer portal and invoices.

Leo (Billing): Verified: Hosted invoices show reversal CM-9901/9902, Dedicated tenant shows credit allocation token on next billing cycle. Accounting ticket ACC-5421 created for audit.

Emily (CSM): NovaHealth notified and relieved. They asked we prevent this going forward. Thanks everyone.

Olivia (Support): Closing support ticket after customer confirms. Follow-up tasks: Mark to file PR to onboarding, Leo to add a check in promo-workflow, Emily to confirm with customer that remaining credit is visible next invoice.

Mark (Engineering): Filing PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/onboarding/pulls/312 (adds tenant_id required flag and match warning).

Olivia (Support): :thumbsup: closing once Emily confirms.
